data.llm_justification: The combination of a -54.7% BL velocity collapse with a critically low PNS answer rate of 16.7% and zero hotlead activity creates a compounding disengagement loop — buyers who do reach out cannot connect, suppressing future enquiry flow further and accelerating the cliff trajectory. The 150 clickstream events and 22 active days suggest the seller is still logging in but not converting activity into meaningful engagement, indicating passive presence rather than active selling intent, which the rule-based model underweights.
llm_interactions: BL velocity collapse (-54.7%) × PNS rate (16.7%): unreachable seller accelerates enquiry dropout, creating a self-reinforcing decline loop
Zero hotleads × TYPE_A sudden cliff: absence of any pipeline activity during a sharp drop signals potential intent-to-leave rather than temporary inactivity

High clickstream (150) + high active days (22) × low reply rate (50.7%) + low PNS (16.7%): passive login behavior without conversion suggests disengagement despite presence, a leading churn indicator the rule model treats as neutral
CQS 80 (healthy) × Amber RAG + velocity collapse: quality score masking operational disengagement may delay intervention if treated as a stabilizing signal

data.reasoning: BL consumption is clearly Green: bl_consumption_rate of 0.886 and reply_rate of 0.138 both exceed all churned sellers and are at the top of the retained cohort, with 59/69 inquiries consumed. LMS activity is Red: call_pickup_ratio of 1.0 looks strong but call_attempts_90d is only 3, far below all churned (41–93) and retained (35–100) sellers, suggesting near-zero inbound call pressure and minimal LMS engagement, while lms_active_days_30d of 22 is decent but not enough to offset. Activity trend is Amber: activity_30d of 150 and event_count of 150 are modest, sitting between churned low-activity sellers and high-activity retained ones, while the recent_enq_trend [16,14,4] shows a sharp declining tail similar to some churned profiles, pulling the band down from Green.

data.cta: Reply YES for a quick setup call

script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Mantram Fashions ke saath baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — dekh raha tha ki aapke account mein pichhle mahine buyers ki taraf se jo BL activity thi, woh 54.7% drop ho gayi hai ek hi mahine mein, toh seedha aapse baat karna zaroori laga.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, aap pehle kaafi active the — 22 din active rehe 30 din mein, CQS bhi 80 hai jo achha hai — toh mujhe samajhna tha ki kya koi specific cheez hui jo aapko buyers se engage karne se rok rahi hai, ya leads ki quality ya quantity mein koi problem feel ho rahi thi aapko?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important baat share karna chahta hoon — aapka PNS success rate sirf 16.7% hai, matlab jab buyers aapko call kar rahe hain, 83% baar connect nahi ho pa raha; yeh directly aapki lead conversion ko hurt kar raha hai, aur agar yeh fix ho jaye toh jo bhi leads aa rahi hain unka response bhi improve hoga.
script_parts.action: Abhi call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — aapka IndiaMART account open karein aur PNS settings check karein, aapka contact number aur availability time sahi set hai ya nahi, 2 minute ka kaam hai aur isse turant fark padega buyers ke connect hone mein.
script_parts.close: Bhai ji, koi pressure nahi hai — bas yeh ek PNS update aaj kar lete hain, aur main 7 din baad ek baar follow-up karunga dekhne ke liye ki BL activity wapas aane lagi ya nahi, theek hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with someone from Mantram Fashions and Apparels? I'm calling from IndiaMART — I noticed your buyer lead activity dropped by 54.7% month-on-month, which is quite a sharp fall, so I wanted to connect with you directly to understand what's happening.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: You've actually been quite engaged — active for 22 out of the last 30 days, and your catalog quality score is a solid 80 — so I wanted to ask: did something specific change recently that made it harder to engage with buyers, or were you feeling that the leads coming in weren't relevant or sufficient?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's a critical data point — your PNS success rate is only 16.7%, meaning when buyers are trying to call you through IndiaMART, they're unable to reach you 83% of the time; this is directly killing your lead conversion even before you get a chance to respond.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one thing together right now on this call — open your IndiaMART account and we'll check your PNS settings together, specifically your contact number and availability hours, it takes just 2 minutes and it will immediately improve how many buyers can actually reach you.
script_parts_en.close: No pressure at all — let's just get this one PNS fix done today, and I'll follow up with you in 7 days to check if your buyer lead activity has started picking up again, does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
